imageDiff.title: Image Compare Pro
imageDiff.description: Compare images side by side, overlay or switch between them to see differences clearly
imageDiff.verticalLayoutTip: Images are displayed vertically due to space constraints
imageDiff.exitTip: Click outside the window to exit
imageDiff.quickCompareTip: Tip: You can select two images at once to start comparing quickly
imageDiff.supportedFormats: Supports common image formats like JPG, PNG, WebP, file size not exceeding 20MB

faq.q1: What is the Image Compare Pro feature?
faq.a1: Image Compare Pro is a professional image difference comparison tool that supports side-by-side display, overlay comparison, and switch viewing modes to help you quickly discover subtle differences between two images.
faq.q2: What image formats and sizes are supported?
faq.a2: We support common image formats including JPG, PNG, WebP, etc., with single image file size not exceeding 20MB. We recommend using high-definition images for better comparison results.
faq.q3: How can I quickly start comparing two images?
faq.a3: You can select two images at once, and the system will automatically load and start comparing. You can also upload the first image first, then upload the second image. Drag-and-drop upload is supported for easy operation.
faq.q4: What are the differences between the three comparison modes?
faq.a4: Side-by-side mode displays two images left and right; overlay mode overlaps two images with adjustable transparency via slider; switch mode allows quick switching between two images, suitable for discovering dynamic differences.
faq.q5: Is this tool free to use?
faq.a5: Yes, Image Compare Pro is completely free to use with no registration or login required. All processing is completed locally in your browser to protect your image privacy and security.
